usageNotes: Returns all named IP/CIDR aliases defined at the cluster firewall level. Aliases are reusable labels (e.g. 'mgmt-net') that can be referenced in cluster or node firewall rules instead of hardcoding CIDRs. Requires Sys.Audit on the root path ('/'); API tokens are supported.
tips: Each alias object includes a 'digest' field — pass it to update/delete calls to prevent concurrent-modification conflicts.
These aliases are cluster-scoped; node- or VM-level aliases are fetched via their respective firewall alias endpoints.
An empty array is a valid response when no aliases have been created yet.
